scope: Deterministic persisted rate-limit policy trace. Incoming 429/Retry-After observations are synthetic; repository persistence/readback is live.

policy.missing_retry_after_backoff_seconds: min(60 * 2^(attempt-1), 300), using the durable attempt number; persist once and never resample on restart
policy.defer_rule: if now < not_before and wait + p90_remaining + retry_reserve <= budget_remaining, DEFER_RATE_LIMIT
policy.switch_rule: if wait + p90_remaining + retry_reserve > budget_remaining OR retry budget is exhausted, SWITCH_PLAN when a predeclared alternative exists
policy.no_alternative_rule: same unsafe condition without an alternative => DEFER_NO_ALTERNATIVE; never blind-retry

events.reason: retry budget exhausted; no safe alternative

restart_invariant: A restart reads persisted attempt/backoff/not_before. It does not draw a new delay and cannot authorize a retry before not_before.

quota_zero_control.reason: The continuation policy depends only on scheduled-Chat reasoning plus lightweight repository state transport; optional quota-bearing execution paths are absent.
